name: links-network
summary: Constellation hero running the tsParticles links preset: 100 drifting nodes joined wherever they come within 150px, over an inline SVG graph that stands in whenever the canvas cannot.

color.description: Node and link colour. Upstream's particles.paint.fill.color.value. Set --fx-node to match so the SVG resting graph agrees.

linkDistance.description: Pixels within which two nodes are joined. Upstream's particles.links.distance.

deviations.what: background: { color: "#000000" } is dropped, so the canvas is transparent.
deviations.why: The section's CSS owns the background and draws the resting SVG graph underneath. Painting #000000 on the canvas would hide the gradient the section is designed around, and the resting state has to show through until the container loads.

deviations.what: Upstream is a preset registered on the engine and applied by name; here the options object is passed straight to engine.load().
deviations.why: A preset only exists to be looked up by name, which a single-effect module has no use for. The options object it registers is what actually configures the container, and that is what travels.

deviations.what: Under prefers-reduced-motion the container is never created.
deviations.why: Effect contract: mount() stays at rest. The SVG constellation is the finished section, so not loading is the resting state rather than a downgrade.
